thread:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're planning to ship the audit schema pivot next week (v2). Need a short customer-facing validation plan + docs for KMS visibility and the RBAC mapping changes. Who can own the sample payloads and the wording for opt-in vs forced customers?

maya: I can draft the sample payloads. Will add examples for KMS-encrypted event metadata and the plain-text fields we keep.

sam: I'll take the RBAC mapping blurb. Need to clarify which roles see key_id vs kms_key_alias in events.

ian: Are we changing any event names or just field shapes? Need to call that out in changelog so customers can grep.

alex: Mostly field shapes + a couple renamed enums. Not renaming top-level event types. Important: we add `actor_auth_method` and `kms_key_visibility` flags.

lia: For customer comms, suggest a short FAQ section: why this is happening, how to validate, and rollback steps. We should include a tiny validation script.

security-bot: Reminder: ensure the draft passes privacy review before external preview. Link: https://go/reviews/privacy-checklist

maya: Sample payload draft (for docs):
```json
{
  "event_type": "config.change",
  "timestamp": "2025-06-21T18:03:00Z",
  "actor": { "id": "user-123", "type": "user" },
  "actor_auth_method": "service_token",
  "resource": { "type": "kms.key", "id": "key-abc" },
  "changes": [{ "field": "rotation_enabled", "old": false, "new": true }],
  "kms_key_visibility": "alias_only" // values: alias_only | full_key_id | obfuscated
}
```

sam: Nice. For RBAC mapping note: customers with `org.admin` continue to see `full_key_id`. Teams with `org.viewer` will see `alias_only`. We'll include mapping table in doc.

ian: Vulnerability triage / incident response note — any audit schema change must maintain parity for forensic search. Add guidance: index migration strategy + retained mapping for 90 days.

alex: Good call. Add explicit rollback snippet: if a customer wants old shape back, route their requests to the compatibility endpoint and we will re-emit legacy fields for 30 days.

lia: Draft comms plan: 1) internal dry-run with GA customers next Tuesday, 2) public preview to opt-in customers for 2 weeks, 3) full flip with email + console banner. I'll draft copy.

maya: I'll create a Gist with sample payloads and example jq checks for customers to run.

sam: Also add a short note about how this affects SIEM mappings (Splunk/Elastic). Provide example transforms.

ian: Action items: maya -> sample payloads + jq checks (ETA Tue 10am), sam -> RBAC mapping doc + SIEM transforms (ETA Tue 2pm), lia -> comms copy + rollout calendar (ETA Tue EOD), alex -> coordinate privacy review + incident instructions.

alex: Thanks all. Ping me if you need approvals. I'll open a PR under `docs/audit-schema-v2` and add a checklist. :thumbsup:
